## Architecture (what's built / where)
- **OCR smart separator** `engine/spec_sculpt/smart_separate.py` — `separate_livery_layers_smart(tex, rotations=(0,1,2,3))`: EasyOCR reads the livery; digits->NUMBERS, words->SPONSORS; tight Otsu glyph masks; 4×90° rotations catch UV-mirrored text; paint=rest. ✅ WIRED into `/api/auto-separate-livery` (server.py ~6549, smart default + classic fallback). Over-protect 0.85->0.96. ~13s/livery (one-time auto pass).
- **Template learner** `_car_intel_learn.py` — `learn_car(car, max=160)`: stacks a car's liveries (512²), per-pixel median (consensus) + std (variance). LOW variance = TEMPLATE/reserved, HIGH = paint. Writes `_car_intel/<slug>/` {median.png, stdev.png, template_mask.png, paintability.png, signature.npz(med 64x64 luma, std 64x64, template_frac), meta.json}. ~12s/car, PIL+numpy only (no engine boot).
- **Learn-all driver** `_car_intel_all.py` — learns ALL 180 cars in priority order (dirt LM -> stockcars -> dirt -> latemodel/trucks -> rest). Kill-safe (skips done via `CAR_INTEL_PROGRESS.jsonl`). RUNNING in background.
- **Car-ID + layers** `engine/spec_sculpt/car_layers.py` — `identify_car(tex)` (ZNCC of livery luma64 vs each car's median sig — WEAK v1, needs edge-based signature) + `separate_into_layers(tex)` -> {numbers, sponsors, template, paint} (OCR layers + template = learned prior ∩ characteristic dark/smooth glass/grill + bright lights; paint = rest).
- **HTML library generator** `_car_intel_html.py` (agent-built) -> `_car_intel/<slug>/index.html` per car + `_car_intel/index.html` master dashboard. Re-runnable as cars finish learning.
